Symphonia 0.6.1
Copyright (c) 2019-2026 The Project Symphonia Developers
Mozilla Public License 2.0; see LICENSE.txt.

The optional portable-loudness backend statically links the AAC-LC / FLAC
decoders and MP4 demuxer. The exact crate versions and checksums are in
rust-runtime/Cargo.lock and src-tauri/Cargo.lock.

Unmodified upstream source and build materials:
https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia/tree/v0.6.1
https://crates.io/crates/symphonia/0.6.1
The bilikara Rust wrapper is separate from the upstream MPL-covered files.
